# Measuring the labor-market effects of remote work policy

## Specific Aims

Aim 1: Advance measuring the labor-market effects of remote work policy via a policy-focused strategy.
Aim 2: Advance measuring the labor-market effects of remote work policy via a policy-focused strategy.

Rigorous, pre-registered analyses will guard against bias and support reproducibility. Prior work has established a partial understanding, yet key gaps remain.
